sentences.text: Criminal Appellate Jurisdiction
Anticipatory Bail Application No. 3627 Of 2023

1. Joseph K. Roy
 2. Soji J. Roy ...Applicants
 V/s.
 State of Maharashtra ...Respondent.
 ..............
 Mr. Sanjay Dubey i/b Mr. Akhlak Khan for the Applicants.
 Mr. B.V. Holambe Patil, App for the Respondent/State.
Psi P.D. Yerankar, Shrinagar Police Station Thane city present.
On 22nd December 2023, this court had passed the following  order.
"1) Heard the learned Counsel for the applicants and the  learned APP for the State.

2) This is an application for pre-arrest bail in connection  with CR. No. 205 of 2023, registered with Shrinagar Police  Station, Thane, for the offences punishable under Sections  406 and 420 read with Section 34 of Indian Penal Code, 1860  ("the Penal Code").
 3) The first informant lodged a report with the allegations  that the applicants, who were employed with Maclareen  Consulting India Pvt. Ltd., had accepted the amount on behalf  of the company in their own name and used the personal  mobile phones instead of the mobile phones provided by the  company and, thereby, defrauded the company to the tune of  Rs.10,000/-.

4) The learned Counsel for the applicants submitted that  on account of the dispute with the officers of the company,
 the applicants had lodged a complaint on 4 th September,
 2023.

To give a counter-blast, the first informant had lodged a Joseph K Roy And Anr vs State Of Maharashtra on 8 September, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/185710789/
1  report on 15th September, 2023.

sentences.text: 5) I have perused the allegations in the FIR.
Prima facie, it  appears that as the applicants and the management fell apart
Dinesh S. Sherla 1/2  ::: Uploaded on - 08/09/2025 ::: Downloaded on - 08/09/2025  21-aba-3627-23.doc  a dispute arose.
In the circumstances, it may be expedient to  grant interim protection to the applicants.
6) Hence, the following order.

:ORDER:
I) In the event of the arrest of the applicants in connection with CR. No. 205 of 2023, registered with Shrinagar Police Station, Thane, for the offences punishable under Sections 406 and 420 read with Section 34 of Indian Penal Code, 1860, the applicants be released on bail on executing a PR Bond in the sum of Rs.30,000/- each, with one or two sureties in the like amount.
II) The applicants shall co-operate with the investigation and attend Shrinagar Police Station,
Thane, on and 5 th and 6th January, 2024 in between 10.00 am to 1.00 pm, and thereafter, as and when directed by the Investigating Officer.
III) The applicants shall not tamper with the prosecution evidence and/or give threat or inducement to the first informant and any of the persons acquainted with the facts of the case.

IV) Stand over to 12th February, 2024"
2. Learned APP, on instructions, submits that the prosecution has filed the charge-sheet against the applicants.
In that view of the matter, the order passed by this court dated 22 nd December 2023 granting interim anticipatory bail to the applicants is hereby confirmed.

3. The Application is disposed of in the aforesaid terms.
[N.R.BORKAR, J.]
